description: Java class 'IntegrationConfiguration' representing external gateway integration settings, including JSON serialization methods and configuration properties.

classes.name: IntegrationConfiguration
classes.description: Represents configuration details for external gateway integration, including environment, module code, activation status, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the configuration.

methods.name: getIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the map of integration keys.

methods.name: setIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Sets the map of integration keys.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Generates a JSON string with core configuration info.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the entire configuration object to a JSON string.

methods.name: setEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the environment (e.g., TEST or PRODUCTION).

methods.name: getIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Returns the map of integration options.

methods.name: setIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Sets the map of integration options.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is default selected.

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Sets whether the configuration is default selected.
